inProgress: Your save is still in progress. You can close this panel.

kept.event: Your entered event name and schedule are kept in this tab. Current access is checked before resuming.
kept.task: Your entered task name and due time are kept in this tab. Current access is checked before resuming.
kept.expense: Your entered expense name, amount, currency and transaction time are kept in this tab. Current access is checked before resuming.
kept.reminder: Your entered reminder name and time are kept in this tab. Current access is checked before resuming.
kept.person: Your entered person's name, email, account link and fields are kept in this tab. Current access is checked before resuming.
kept.note: Your entered note title and text are kept in this tab. Current access is checked before resuming.

failedRetry: The previous save could not be confirmed. Resume and retry unchanged fields to reuse the same save attempt.
failedCheck: The previous save could not be confirmed. Check whether it was saved before trying again.
lastSaveFailed: The last save failed. Check for a saved event before submitting again.
full: Draft recovery is full while other saves are pending. Keep this editor open.
stays: Drafts stay in this tab until reload or sign-out.
